description: You remember, right, Captain? Today's the day of the [basic trial]. Are you fully prepared? ...More or less. Haha, sounds like someone's feeling confident. Today's opponent in the [basic trial] will be members of Candle Square.
name: Basic Trial

description: ... Are you okay? That was quite a hard fall. Heh... Heheh... Heh... Hahaha! Not bad at all! To have toppled the mighty Dragon! You! Are my equal! Ah... On second thought, maybe that's exaggerating...
name: Basic Trial Victory

description: A-are you all right? I might've hit a bit too hard just now... I-it wasn't on purpose, I swear! I didn't mean to go that far... It's fine. I'm not hurt... Are you sure...? Mm, but enduring one of my attacks without flinching is no small feat. Very well! I admire that spirit.
name: Basic Trial Defeat

description: I heard the results of the basic trial. Well done, Captain. From now on, the real [Journey] begins. I actually came to let you know that the schedule for the next trial has been set. The next trial is the [hunt trial].
name: Hunt Trial Preparations

description: I arrived at [Starshard Fortress] to carry out the hunt trial. As expected, dozens of Raider packs had gathered there for a rally. But then... Warm... Krrgh... Yes... Chief right. Feels like we home again... Krrgh... What you talking about? Our home just past mountain...
name: Hunt Trial

description: Krrgh! Them! Nothing special! Weak! They not weak! We strong! Right! We invincible if chief leads us! Hear me, warriors! We march forward! We plunder the Heart of the Star! We plunder Saviors! One day, we even plunder the stars in the sky! Great chief! Me, Kiriyas, follow you forever! Observation...
name: Hunt Trial Defeat

description: Ah, there you are, Captain. I've been waiting for quite a while. You look cheerful today. Did you get your heating bill sorted out? Oh, that? Actually, NOA's Central Bank recently launched a new loan program to support young residents.
name: Region Transition: Aganon

description: Look, Captain! It's the ocean! I've only ever heard about it before... this is my first time actually seeing it in person. The blazing sunlight! The glittering sands! The cool, endless waves! Doesn't it make your heart race, Captain? Your outfit's surprisingly bold...
name: Seaside City, Flora

description: Citizens of Flora! I hope you've all been enjoying the beach volleyball tournament! Today marks the long-awaited day of the grand finals! I took time off just to see this! Give us a match to remember! After fierce battles, only two teams remain...
name: Beach Volleyball Finals

description: After driving back the approaching monsters, I turned to find that the spectators, who should have been evacuated, were still there...
name: Beach Volleyball Finals Victory

success_rewards.description: Everyone has a past they would rather forget. Strength gained during training decreases.
success_rewards.name: Shameful Memories: Flora

description: Players, are you all right? The monsters have been driven off. The city is safe now. That's a relief. What about the crowd? Are they safe? Everyone's unharmed. Thanks to brave individuals like you who didn't hesitate to take the lead. Come on, let me help you up.
name: Beach Volleyball Finals Defeat

description: ... ... ... Today's the day we go back... Yeah... but you haven't even changed clothes yet? ... ...Lisa, are you okay? You've got bags under your eyes, and your hair's all frizzy... No... I don't wanna go back... ... Overtime, reports, administrative work... I hate all of it...
name: End of Flora Training Camp

description: Hello, Captain! Did you rest well? I was worried the trip might've worn you out, but... Haha, you look fine to me. I still remember how uncertain you looked when you first started the [Journey]... Compared to back then, both you and your Journey member have grown so much. Well, that's only natural.
name: Competition Trial Preparations

description: Hello, Captain. Today is the day of the [competition trial]. The [Western Liberators] are already here. Hey, hey! You're early, Journey Captain! Have you had breakfast yet? If you're hungry, would you like to have one of these? Is that...? It's mint chocolate ice cream.
name: Competition Trial

description: With a heavy impact, my vision went completely dark. When I came to, both I and my Journey member were lying on the ground. Whew... Is that all you've got? ...Soft! To challenge the [Journey] with such meager skill is pure arrogance! Next time, come back after honing your strength.
name: Competition Trial Defeat

description: With a new companion joining your ranks, it's time to push forward toward the final stage of the Journey. But before that, there's one announcement I'd like to share. Another trial? Haha, unfortunately, not this time. This one's a bit more cheerful.
name: Region Transition: Training Camp

description: ...Achoo! Brrr. It's so cold... Are you all right? No. I've just always been a bit weak against the cold... Still, this is a great chance to experience the benefits of Kalaid's hot springs firsthand. Benefits? Kalaid's hot springs don't just ease fatigue, they're said to greatly enhance vitality.
name: Snowfall City, Kalaid

description: The streets of Kalaid were unusually noisy. Sturdy townsfolk had gathered, equipped with cold weather gear and hunting tools. Those people are heading out to dig for a new water source. The recent disturbance destroyed several of the main springs to the point of no repair.
name: Escorting the Waterway Expedition

description: Thanks to the successful development of a new water source, the festival opened in full splendor. My friends! There you are! We managed to hold the festival safely, all thanks to you. I don't even know how to thank you enough.
name: Escorting the Waterway Expedition Victory

success_rewards.description: Everyone has a past they would rather forget. Vitality gained during training decreases.
success_rewards.name: Shameful Memories: Kalaid

description: The monsters were driven back, but the exhaustion and injuries meant we'd have to rest for a while... Are you feeling all right? Thanks to you both fighting so hard, the festival was able to open safely. What a shame. The festival just begin, and you're stuck in bed like this... I'm fine.
name: Escorting the Waterway Expedition Defeat

description: Hello, Captain! It's almost time to depart. Have you packed everything? Yeah. And you look surprisingly well. Oh my, do I? You think so too, Captain? I didn't know this before, but apparently the hot springs here are excellent for your skin.
name: End of Kalaid Training Camp

description: Hello, Captain. Have you recovered from the fatigue of the training camp? I still can't shake off the feeling of that vacation—I mean, training camp. I got plenty of rest. Haha, I'm glad to hear that. Today, I'll be briefing you on the next trial approved by the headquarters.
name: Void Trial Preparations

description: You're here, Captain. Where are we? This is the underground complex beneath NOA's central district. It's a sacred altar commonly known as [Dirac's Well]. Dirac's Well? Yes. Voidborns are beings that exist beyond this world.
name: Void Trial

description: Congratulations, Captain. You've successfully triumphed in the Void trial. With this, you and your Journey member have officially proven yourselves worthy to protect Lavistar from the Void. It feels like only yesterday you first began the [Journey] and you've come so far. Truly remarkable.
name: Void Trial Victory

description: A chilling cold seeped in through my wound. It was a cold, suffocating darkness... the Void... that felt as if it was gnawing away at my very soul. My consciousness faded away in the cold. Observation complete.
name: Void Trial Defeat

description: Hello, Captain. The next trial is the [final trial]. ...At last, we've reached the end. How does it feel? Looking back, it didn't feel all that long, did it? Do you feel a bit of regret that it's ending? No, I just want it to be over already. It does feel a little bittersweet.
name: Final Trial Preparations

description: ...Is that really all you've got? Compared to what I was expecting, this was unbearably dull. Very well. The Cycle keeps turning, after all. Still... I deserve a little fun for myself, don't you think? A payment for this long, dreary boredom. It felt like an eternity...
name: Final Trial Defeat

description: Welcome, Captain. Welcome to [Candle Square Aganon Branch]. So there's a Candle Square here too. Yes. It's so Saviors can receive the same level of support as they did in NOA, no matter where they are in Lavistar. Each branch's interiors reflect the local culture.
name: Expedition Trial Preparations

description: According to the information we've gathered so far, the ancient construct we're looking for should be somewhere around here. But... no matter how I look at it, something's off. This path has long been the route explorers use to reach the deep layers.
name: Expedition Trial

description: After a fierce battle, we finally defeated the [ancient construct]. It dissolved into shimmering particles of light, leaving only a few remains behind. Ch-chief! Ancient construct fallen! Fools! No panic! Everything going as chief planned! Chief already has next phase in mind. Right, chief?! ...
name: Expedition Trial Victory

description: Krrgh! Ancient construct struck down intruders! Labyrinth belongs to us! Humans become slaves, forced to supply us hot water! Chief! Decide how we deal with them! Ahh... humans always humiliate us. This time... our turn to humiliate them. Many times over what we suffered! Observation complete.
name: Expedition Trial Defeat

description: Ah, you're already here, Captain! Sorry, I'm a bit late today, aren't I? That's unusual for you. Haha, I've been busy with the establishment of the [Explorer Association] I mentioned back in Aganon.
name: Region Transition: NOA

description: Hello, Captain! I've been waiting for you. At last, your [Journey] begins today. You'll soon meet the [Journey member] who'll be traveling alongside you.
name: Starting Point

description: Did you have a good introduction with your Journey member, Captain? Today, I'll be explaining the first trial that's about to take place. The first test will be held at Candle Square, and is called the [basic trial].
name: Basic Trial Preparations

description: While walking down the street, a girl handing out flyers called out to me. Ah! Hello there! Um... are you the [Journey Captain] personally appointed by Lady [Alicia]? You know who I am? I knew it was you! I saw you once from afar when I was delivering goods to Candle Square.
name: They're Coming

description: So... you're saying the Raiders keep attacking the wagons carrying food supplies? How peculiar. It's not even the kind of season where Raiders should be going hungry.
name: Raiders Encounter

success_rewards.description: Slightly increases self DEF by a certain percentage.
success_rewards.name: Sense of Defense

description: Excellent work, Captain. It's clear these Raiders were far larger in scale and better organized than most. To have fought through such a group and reclaimed both the wagon and the supplies... That's a remarkable achievement, and proof that even amidst hardship, you've upheld your duty as a Savior.
name: Raiders Encounter Victory

description: Captain, the escaped Raiders have been dealt with by the Public Security. The wagon was damaged, but the food supplies meant for Cafe Strega were safely recovered. That was thanks to the time you managed to buy.
name: Raiders Encounter Defeat

description: After finishing training and returning to my room, I found a package left at my door. A package with no sender? Hmph, don't look at me. I'd never waste my time on such childish pranks. What do you take the a Rhys for? You probably just forgot about some promotional giveaway you signed up for.
name: The Journey's Gift

description: Hmm... Was it this way? Or that way? Oh dear... they'll start worrying if I'm late... Are you lost, ma'am? Ah, I'm sorry. I suppose I've been flustered—quite unbecoming for someone my age. I came to visit my son and his wife, but this is my first time in such a big city.
name: A Gift of Kindness

description: While tracking traces of the monster that appeared in the labyrinth, the ground suddenly began to shake violently. Thank goodness! Someone's here...! Please, you have to help me! Calm down first. What happened? During patrol, the ground collapsed after an earthquake... and my team got caught in it.
name: A Gift of Rescue

description: P-please help! My child fell into the river! Oh no! He's being swept away! The current must be strong from the rain the other day...! We dove into the river together to save the child. The current was fiercer than usual. By the time we pulled the child out, we were already downstream.
name: A Model Gift

description: When we reached the beach, people were singing and dancing. Every year around this time, Flora holds a prayer festival. We welcome the divine being with delicious food, joyful songs, and cheerful dances. Soon... Just then, a great spout of water burst up from the middle of the sea.
name: A Gift of Happiness

description: While we were walking through the Kalaid plaza, a huge dog suddenly charged at me and leapt into my arms. Woof! Woof! The heavy creature pinned me down, wagging its tail furiously as it licked my cheek nonstop.
name: Gift of Connection

description: ...An accident occurred during training. It turned out the cause was poor maintenance of our training equipment, neglected due to our busy schedules. When I rushed to the infirmary, the doctor said she'd need to rest for a while.
name: Accidents Happen

description: Maybe we got too caught up in training—before we knew it, the entire training ground floor had been dug up. While cleaning up with [CHARACTER_NAME]... Something seemed to be buried inside the dug-up pit. This is...
name: An Unexpected Discovery

description: While checking the quest board, I found a notice seeking an old box. Remembering the [Suspicious Box] we dug up during training, we decided to meet the client... Oh... the framing style and locking mechanism on this... There's no doubt it's one of the Monolith Order's creations.
name: The Order's Lost Item

failure_rewards.description: Overtraining has taken its toll. Training failure rate increases.
failure_rewards.name: Overexertion

choices.label: Throw all I've got into training and believe it pays off!

success_rewards.description: Pressure has a positive effect. Potential Points gained during training increase.
success_rewards.name: Deadline Effect

choices.label: Train a bit more than usual.
Be satisfied with the usual pace.

description: While training for the next trial... Ah... Hello, Captain? I brought you a cool towel. You looked exhausted from training. Th-thanks? I recognized her as one of the maids who mostly handled clerical work—someone I rarely saw.
name: Unexpected Encouragement

choices.label: How to master the punching machine.

success_rewards.description: You feel accustomed to the strain on your body. Strength gained during training increases.
success_rewards.name: Surpassing Limits

success_rewards.description: You keep challenging yourself until powerful foes are defeated. Vitality gained during training increases.
success_rewards.name: Reckless Challenge

description: Lately, our progress in the [Journey] has been underwhelming. I'd been dwelling on it, feeling lost and unsure, when... Um... excuse me, I'm sorry to interrupt. Were you perhaps worrying about how to train more effectively? You hit the mark. I'd appreciate any advice you have.
name: The Secret Training from Hell

choices.label: I won't forget what I've learned.
We still have more to learn.

description: It's been quite some time since we began the secret training from hell. During that time, [CHARACTER_NAME] has shown remarkable growth... But the one who taught us the regimen looked paler by the day... Congratulations. You no longer need to worry about training.
name: Strength Training Results

description: The Observer from the [Journey] support department, whom I'd met before, came by again. I'm so sorry, Captain! I was supposed ask for your feedback afterward delivering the supplies, but I completely forgot about it... You mean this questionnaire? Oh no...

description: While organizing supplies, a faint, unfamiliar light began to shine from the back of the room. The light was coming from the sword we'd brought back earlier from the statue in the forest. At times like this...
name: The Power Hidden in the Sword

description: While we were deeply focused on training, a suspicious outsider appeared. Muhuhu... There you are, Captain. I should report this to the maids. There's a peddler here. Peddler? How rude. I am a respectable alchemist.
name: The Completed Enhancer?

description: While checking the quest board at Candle Square, I found a rather unusual posting. It was from someone searching for the first screening bonus of the film The 13th Voidborn 13. That reminded me of the movie I watched on my last day off... Oh, welcome, Journey Captain. I got your reply.
name: The Collector's Visit

choices.label: Sell the relic to the Order.
Hold on to it for now.

description: Captain, may I have a moment of your time? A priest from the Monolith Order has come to see you. He says he has something he'd like to discuss with you. My apologies for arriving unannounced, Captain. The reason for my visit today concerns the [Mysterious Relic] in your possession.
name: The Order's Proposal

choices.label: Say that relics need to be handled with care.

description: After finishing my meal, I was reviewing today's training schedule when... ...I suddenly felt a persistent gaze from around the corner. Do you need something from us? Muhuhu. You caught me. Such sharp perception... As expected of the man I've personally acknowledged, [Journey Captain].
name: A Simple Test

description: As I left the Astro Sanctum and arrived at the training grounds, a young girl was waiting for me. She looked in my direction, then approached me without hesitation as she held out her hand. Something about her face felt strangely familiar... or was it just my imagination? Hi.
name: First Encounter

description: Dear Captain. Before you begin your [Journey], let me tell you about [Candle Square]. Candle Square? Yes, NOA also handles providing support to Saviors throughout Lavistar. Candle Square is one of NOA's main departments that handles those duties.
name: Candle Square

description: Oh, Captain. You're here early. Oh? You're wondering what this is about? Fufu, I'm here to share some good news with you.
name: Apocalypse

description: Captain, I have some good news. Today is the day we'll be joined by a companion recommended by the [Polaris] Observation Council. A [Companion]? Yes. From now on, a [companion] can assist you in Journey trials. They can join you in missions as well as [trials].
name: About Companions

description: *Sigh*... I really need to stay on top of my performance as well, or else... ...Are Observers under a lot of pressure to perform? Don't even get me started. We're sent out into the field all the time, and the paperwork for every procedure just keeps piling up...
name: New Party!

description: Ah, you've arrived, Captain. Just on time. So that's them? The rookies for the Basic Trial? Yes, they're members of the Voyager Savior Party taking part in this [Journey] trial. And Captain. Allow me to introduce [Bell Rhys], a maid of Candle Square and its gravekeeper.
name: Battle Evaluation

description: ...Impressive. I’ve never seen this level of performance in a new Savior’s battle evaluation. I see. So you do have what it takes to be personally recruited by Lady Alicia. ...I’ll admit—you’re a rather promising rookie. I’ll have the finest gravestone prepared for the day I collect your remains.
name: Battle Evaluation Victory

description: ...This is the end. Not bad, but I’m a bit concerned about taking on the [Journey] at this level. See? Most of them are just fools drunk on legends. Well, you weren’t all that different either.
name: Battle Evaluation Defeat

description: That's... the opponent for the final trial. The Executor of Aldebaran, [Gille]. ...Careful, everyone. I've been trying to make a divination for a while now, I can't see anything. Predicting her combat patterns... may not be possible.
name: Dirac's Well

description: Are you alright, everyone?! Are you hurt?! ...Okay. We're all good. The Executor of Aldebaran, [Gille]... Extermination confirmed. You... really defeated her! Hah! As Lavistar's greatest oracle, I already knew how this was going to play out.
name: The End of the Journey
